findings.title: Coverage and quality of comparable MAST diagnostics
findings.method: Catalog selection fixed before values; explicit unit conversion and finite/regular-sampling checks
findings.uncertainty: Missingness is counted; source calibration uncertainty unknown
findings.limits: Source Level2 diagnostic processing release retained; instrument/physics validation is not asserted.

findings.title: Temporal and spectral characterization of source measurements
findings.method: Finite contiguous regular segments, SciPy FFT/Welch/STFT, explicit Hann/overlap/resolution, derivative excursions
findings.uncertainty: Frequency-bin and time-grid resolution; window/filter/threshold sensitivity; no total calibration error
findings.limits: Peaks and transients are not identified MHD modes, ELMs or disruptions.

findings.title: Cross-shot spread and parameter sensitivity
findings.method: Report all selected shots and all declared spectral/filter/event settings; same-shot descriptive correlation only

numerical_result.interpretation: Same catalog campaign/shape/current category, not controlled identical experiments; no phase alignment, performance ranking or causal inference.
Same catalog campaign/shape/current category, not controlled identical experiments; no phase alignment, performance ranking or causal inference.

findings.uncertainty: Observed cross-shot dispersion and method sensitivity; small selected cohort, not population inference
findings.limits: Differences may reflect unmeasured experimental settings or processing; no causal plasma conclusion.

limitations: Legacy mastapp JSON service timed out; current official documentation points to the public S3 Parquet catalogs actually used.
Level2 magnetics metadata identifies source ingestion commit/release; a processed diagnostic is not a direct equilibrium reconstruction.
No interpolation, missing-to-zero conversion or sorting of bad time axes; spectral analysis uses declared contiguous segments.
Sample deliberately matches catalog categories, not all physical operating conditions; no cross-shot phase alignment.
Source release documents ongoing corrections; quality metrics and source-version metadata accompany every result.
No new instability, confinement improvement, disruption forecast, physical law or causal effect established.
Statistical block intervals and discretization/sensitivity do not quantify unknown instrument/calibration systematics.
